text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final. 11 Yorkville Partners Inc., is constructing a 62-storey residential condominium building with ground floor retail at 11-25 Yorkville Avenue West. The site is located on the south side of Yorkville Avenue mid-block between Yonge Street and Bay Street. Transportation Services is requesting authorization to close the south sidewalk and a two-metre-wide portion of the eastbound curb lane on Yorkville Avenue, between a point 53 metres west of Yonge Street and a point 55 metres further west, for a period of 43 months (i.e., May 20, 2021 to December 31, 2024) to accommodate a construction staging area. The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the closure of the south sidewalk and a two-metre-wide portion of the eastbound curb lane on Yorkville Avenue, between a point 53 metres west of Yonge Street and a point 55 metres further west, from, May 20, 2021 to December 31, 2024. 2. Amended the existing standing prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Yorkville Avenue, between and a point 119.5 metres east of Bay Street and Yonge Street to be in effect from Yonge Street and a point 50 metres further west. 3. Prohibited stopping at all times on the north side of Yorkville Avenue, between a point 50 metres west of Yonge Street and a point 119.5 metres east of Bay Street. 4.
